text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: LowRes NX is a fantasy console designed to recreate the experience of developing and playing games on classic 8-bit hardware. It provides a simple programming environment with built-in graphics, sound, and input systems. Inspired by early home computers and consoles, LowRes NX allows users to create and share small games using a custom BASIC-style language while focusing on retro game design.
